records.question: Why does Berkshire Hathaway report total revenue for 2021 as USD 276,094 million in its fiscal 2021 annual filing and USD 276,203 million in its fiscal 2022 annual filing? Identify only a cause explicitly supported by these filings, retain the two source scopes, and reconcile the displayed difference to the extent the filings permit.
records.required_answer_behavior: Report the source-scoped amounts and numeric pattern; abstain from the specific causal explanation until an explicit source premise is acquired.
